factual_entities.name_hi: बिहू उत्सव, असम का सामुदायिक भोज और मध्याह्न भोजन
attributes: Bihu Festival: Celebrated in ASSAM for new rice crop; Magh Bihu on 14-15 January (1st & 2nd Magh); first day is URUKA; temporary shelter BHELAGHAR made of BAMBOO AND THATCH for community feast; morning bonfire (Meji)
Assam Rice: BORA (sticky rice variety) and CHEVA (Bora rice steamed in large Kadhahi / Tao covered with banana leaves)
Mid-Day Meal Scheme: Legal right of every primary school child in India to hot, cooked nutritious food; promotes caste/social equality

geographical_locations_and_tribes.name: Assam
geographical_locations_and_tribes.context: Bihu harvest festival and paddy cultivation

visual_assets_and_diagram_cues: Bhelaghar structure, Bihu dance with Dhol and Pepa, Cheva rice pot over fire
